event.description:
Entree Fees: RM 45

All participants will receive 2 Mercurial Hearts Booster Packs as their participating prize and the Sable Remnant as participation prize.
 
Prize Structure
1st Place: Store Championship Card + Store Championship Playmat + 3 Mercurial Hearts Booster Packs, + 4 Gold Event Pack, + 5 Silver Event Pack 
2nd Place: 5 Mercurial Hearts Booster Packs, + 3 Gold Event Pack, + 3 Silver Event Pack 
3rd & 4th Place: 2 Mercurial Hearts Booster Packs, + 2 Gold Event Pack, + 2 Silver Event Pack 
5th ~ 8th Place: 1 Mercurial Hearts Booster Packs, + 1 Gold Event Pack, + 1 Silver Event Pack 
9th ~16th Place: 2 Silver Event Pack 
17th ~32nd Place: 1 Silver Event Pack 

Lucky Draw: NF Idle thoughts and more!

*Players are reminded to be punctual as the game will start exactly at 1.00 PM.
